epics.title: Restore Missing Commits for Closed Tasks
epics.jtbd: When the client reports missing deliveries for multiple closed tasks, I want the missing commits restored and integrated, so that the main branch correctly contains the full expected functionality.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Missing code defect count from 85 to 0
requirements: R1: Restore and merge the missing commits for all closed tasks listed in Brief #0.

slices.title: Integrate Missing Commits for Closed Tasks
slices.jtbd: When restoring missing functionality for this epic, I want to integrate the missing commits, so that all closed tasks are present on the main branch.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a list of missing closed tasks
When the main branch is examined
Then all corresponding commits must be integrated.
Given the integrations
When the deployment triggers
Then it must succeed without conflicts.

slices.title: QA Verification for Restored Commits
slices.jtbd: When validating the restored deliverables for this epic, I want to verify all restored components, so that the system functions correctly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the missing commits are restored
When tests are run
Then all layers of the test pyramid must pass.
Given the restored functionality
When end-to-end tests run
Then they must execute without errors.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Test pass rate from X to 100%

epics.title: Resolve Datastore Configuration Discrepancy
epics.jtbd: When runtime artifacts disagree about the datastore, I want to update the runtime contract to define a single source of truth, so that configuration conflicts are resolved.
requirements: R1: Update docs/architecture/adr-002-runtime-contract.md to explicitly specify the single intended datastore engine.

slices.title: Update Runtime Contract
slices.jtbd: When updating the runtime contract for this epic, I want to clarify the datastore choice, so that configurations match the contract.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a discrepancy between tc and postgresql configurations
When ADR-002 is examined
Then it must explicitly define the datastore.
Given the datastore is defined
When system configuration is checked
Then it must align with the defined datastore.

slices.title: QA for Runtime Contract Update
slices.jtbd: When verifying the runtime contract update for this epic, I want to ensure the configuration aligns with the new specification, so that the system builds correctly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the updated runtime contract
When the system starts
Then it must use the configured datastore consistently.
Given integration tests
When they execute
Then they must use the expected datastore.

epics.title: Fix Frontend Mock Data Display
epics.jtbd: When the frontend page displays mock records, I want components to render actual server data with multiple states, so that users see real domain records.
requirements: R1: Replace hardcoded data in DossierSearch and NavigationHub with dynamic server responses (handling empty, loading, error, and present states).

R2: Stated explicitly: the other links of the Epidemiological Hub chain (e.g. generate signed PDF, root cause transmission evaluate, cryptographic integrity verification) are outside the scope of this frontend mock replacement task, as this is a follow-up patch targeting just the UI presentation.

slices.title: Replace Hardcoded Frontend Records
slices.jtbd: When modifying Svelte components for this epic, I want to use dynamic server data, so that static mocks are eliminated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend returns zero rows
When the frontend page is loaded
Then it must display an empty state and no hardcoded documents.
Given the UI components
When interacted via keyboard and screen readers
Then they must be accessible and compliant with WCAG 2.1 AA.

slices.title: QA for Frontend Data Accuracy
slices.jtbd: When testing the frontend changes for this epic, I want to ensure components render data correctly under all states, so that no false information is shown.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the frontend handles multiple states
When different server responses are simulated
Then the correct state (empty, loading, error, present) must be displayed.
Given accessibility tools
When the components are scanned
Then no WCAG 2.1 AA violations should exist.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Incorrect UI states from X to 0

epics.title: Product Goal-Question-Metric Measurement Base
epics.jtbd: When evaluating the product's overall effectiveness, I want to answer core business questions via telemetry, so that I know if the Epidemiological Hub is achieving its purpose of finding and analyzing pathogen records.
requirements: R1: Goal: Facilitate accurate epidemiological research. Question: Are researchers successfully finding and analyzing protocol dossiers? Metric: Rate of successful protocol searches leading to valid dossier downloads.

slices.title: Implement Baseline GQM Metrics
slices.jtbd: When implementing the measurement logic for this epic, I want to establish baseline telemetry for the Epidemiological Hub, so that core product questions about research efficacy can be answered.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the metrics requirement
When telemetry is generated
Then it must correctly output the rate of successful protocol searches.
Given the metrics collector
When it runs on production logs
Then it must capture accurate data without performance loss.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Metric evaluation latency from X to Y
